# Ares Security LLC

> Ares Security is a minority woman-owned security guard company based in Colorado Springs, Colorado, founded in 2021. It provides licensed and bonded armed and unarmed security officers, mobile patrol, access control, and event security for federal, commercial, industrial, and institutional sites in Colorado Springs, Denver, and Pueblo. Federal agencies can order through its GSA Multiple Award Schedule, contract 47QSMS25D009Q.

Key facts, each checkable on the linked pages:

- Ownership and certifications: minority woman-owned; SBA Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB250470); WBENC certified Women's Business Enterprise (WBE2303571); Denver M/WBE and SBE certified; Colorado Verified Diverse Business and Colorado Verified Small Business.
- Federal identifiers: GSA MAS 47QSMS25D009Q (SIN 561612), NAICS 561612 (Security Guards and Patrol Services), UEI XQXDN6E33SF4, CAGE 9KL18. Active on SAM.gov through March 26, 2027. Eligible for WOSB set-aside awards under NAICS 561612.
- Licensing: Colorado has no statewide security license; cities license security companies. Ares holds city licenses in Colorado Springs (0850744L), Denver (2021-BFN-0001984), and Pueblo (26422), and is an approved armed and unarmed training provider in each.
- Service area: Colorado Springs (headquarters, ZIP 80906), Denver, and Pueblo, along the Front Range of Colorado.
- Record: under 1% missed shifts since 2021; across five past performance evaluations, clients rated Ares Very Good or Exceptional on 43 of 45 criteria, none below Satisfactory; employees rate it 4.8 out of 5 on Indeed.
- How posts are staffed: a member of Ares leadership trains each officer on the post and works the first shift on every new post; on-call coverage is written into every contract. Armed officers are firearms-qualified by Ares's veteran NRA-certified firearms instructor. Supervisors include veterans.
- Federal experience: access control, escort, and vehicle inspection for restricted areas on military installations, alongside base security forces.
- Contact: 719-696-3966, contact@aressecurity.co. Careers: careers@aressecurity.co.

- [Teaming and subcontracting](https://aressecurity.co/teaming): For primes, guard companies, and builders: restricted-area escorts, access control officers, and relief, overflow, and surge coverage; woman-owned subcontracting credit.
- [Request a quote](https://aressecurity.co/contact): Send the site, the coverage needed, and the schedule.

## Services

- [All security services](https://aressecurity.co/services): Six services, the six industries Ares protects (Government & Military; Critical & High-Liability Sites; Construction, Industrial & Logistics; Airport & Transportation; Commercial & Retail; Institutional & Community), and how a contract starts.
- [Armed security officers](https://aressecurity.co/services/armed-security-officers): Licensed, firearms-qualified armed officers.
- [Unarmed security officers](https://aressecurity.co/services/unarmed-security-officers): Uniformed and plainclothes officers for lobbies, perimeters, and public areas.
- [Access control](https://aressecurity.co/services/access-control): Credential checks, visitor screening, and gate, dock, and lobby control, with auditable logs.
- [Mobile patrol](https://aressecurity.co/services/mobile-patrol): Marked-vehicle patrol, after-hours checks, alarm response, and time-stamped reports.
- [Event security](https://aressecurity.co/services/event-security): Crowd management, entry screening, and one plan shared with staff and venue.
- [Restricted-area escort](https://aressecurity.co/services/restricted-area-escort): Escort for crews, visitors, and deliveries inside controlled areas, with people and vehicles verified and custody logs.

## Industries

- [Government & Military](https://aressecurity.co/industries/government-military): Officers for federal, state, and municipal facilities and military installations, available through GSA MAS.
- [Critical & High-Liability Sites](https://aressecurity.co/industries/critical-infrastructure): Data centers, utilities, cash-handling, and other regulated sites where every entry is documented; armed posts where required.
- [Construction, Industrial & Logistics](https://aressecurity.co/industries/construction-industrial): Gate control, perimeter rounds, and after-hours patrol for builds, yards, and warehouses.
- [Airport & Transportation](https://aressecurity.co/industries/airport-transportation): Airport-area sites, transit and parking facilities, and cargo operations Ares is ready to staff.
- [Commercial & Retail](https://aressecurity.co/industries/commercial-property): Offices, retail, banks, and hotels, with patrol across a portfolio.
- [Institutional & Community](https://aressecurity.co/industries/institutional-community): Hospitals, schools, campuses, and apartment communities.
